content.title: Diamond Hill (DHIL) Net Profit Margin Rises to 31.7%, Reinforcing Value Narrative
content.summary: Diamond Hill Investment Group (DHIL) posted a net profit margin of 31.7%, up from 29% last year, as the company delivered 16.3% earnings growth over the past year. This marks a stark improvement from its five-year average annual decline of 5%. Shares closed at $126.29, which remains well below the estimated fair value of $183.16 and is trading at a price-to-earnings multiple of just 7.2x, noticeably under both the US Capital Markets industry average of 25.2x and its peers at 44.2x.
